decisions.rationale: 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy' is used as a modifier of the noun 'gene' in 'the human X-linked Duchenne muscular dystrophy gene', so the disease name is annotated as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: In 'the Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) gene', the disease name modifies the noun 'gene', so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'DMD' is the abbreviation defined by the parenthetical after the long form; it is a separate synonymous mention and, like the long form, serves as a modifier of 'gene'.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6: Annotate all synonymous mentions; What to Annotate 3: Modifiers

decisions.rationale: 'disease' in 'this genetic disease' is a very general term and is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4: Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: 'muscular dystrophy' denotes a family of multiple specific diseases, so it is a Disease Class mention.
'mdx' names the mouse mutant that displays a specific muscular dystrophy phenotype; the disease caused by it is clearly being discussed, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 1: organism exception when the disease is discussed; What to Annotate 1: Specific Disease

decisions.rationale: 'DMD' in 'the DMD locus' modifies the noun 'locus', so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'the pathological features of mdx' refers to the specific disease condition of mdx as a standalone noun phrase, so it is a Specific Disease.
'the Becker muscular dystrophy type' uses the disease name as a modifier of the noun 'type', so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'linkage of mdx to G6PD' uses mdx as a standalone reference to the specific mutant/disease rather than modifying a noun, so it is a Specific Disease.
'the mdx mutation' uses 'mdx' as a modifier of the noun 'mutation', so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'Emery Dreifuss muscular dystrophy' is a single, specific disease with no further categorization, used as a standalone noun phrase.
'linked to DMD on the human X chromosome' uses DMD as a standalone disease reference, not as a modifier of a noun, so it is a Specific Disease.
'the mdx mutation' uses 'mdx' as a modifier of the noun 'mutation', so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'a DMD cDNA clone' uses DMD as a modifier of the noun phrase 'cDNA clone', so it is a Modifier.
